statCard.name: Nick Fury & The Howling Commandos
statCard.alterEgo: Nicholas Fury, Sr., Timothy "Dum Dum" Dugan, Gabriel Jones

attacks.name: Prototype Weapons
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Pursuit|: Before damage is dealt, this character may Advance Toward the defender |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Grenades!
steps: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: The Show‘s Over
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
|!wild| |*Pour It On|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make a |*Prototype Weapons| attack.

superPowers.name: Siblings in Arms
superPowers.body: Choose another allied character within |!range| 2 of this character. Place this character within |!range| 1 of the chosen character or Place the chosen character within |!range| 1 of this character. A character can be Placed by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Got Your Back
superPowers.body: When an allied character is Dazed or KO'd by an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, this character may use this superpower. This character makes a |*Prototype Weapons| attack against the enemy character that caused the effect.
